description: 10-year (2016-2025) JEE Main & JEE Advanced open-source style PYQ & prep bank (Physics, Chemistry). Expand further via scripts/import_opensource_pyqs.py.

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The moment of inertia of a solid sphere of mass M and radius R about its diameter is:
questions.explanation: For a uniform solid sphere about any diameter, I = (2/5) MR² (whereas a hollow thin spherical shell has (2/3) MR²).
questions.source: JEE Main 2016 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 7

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: For a spontaneous process at constant temperature and pressure, the Gibbs free energy change (ΔG) must be:
questions.explanation: At constant T and P, spontaneity requires ΔG = ΔH - TΔS < 0.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2016 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 6

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: A body of mass 2 kg moves with velocity 10 m/s. Its kinetic energy is:
questions.source: JEE Main 2017 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 6

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: At 298 K, the relationship between standard cell potential E°cell and equilibrium constant K is:
questions.explanation: From Nernst equation at equilibrium (Ecell = 0, Q = K), E°cell = (2.303 RT / nF) log10 K = (0.0591 / n) log10 K at 298 K.
questions.source: JEE Main 2017 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 3

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: If the length of a simple pendulum is quadrupled (4L), its time period T becomes:
questions.explanation: T = 2π√(L/g) ∝ √L. Replacing L with 4L multiplies T by √4 = 2.
questions.source: JEE Main 2018 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 14

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: The maximum number of electrons that can be accommodated in a subshell with azimuthal quantum number l = 2 (d-subshell) is:
questions.explanation: A subshell has (2l + 1) orbitals and holds at most 2(2l + 1) electrons. For l = 2, 2(4 + 1) = 10 electrons.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2018 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 2

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The power of a thin convex lens of focal length +25 cm in air is:
questions.explanation: Power P = 1 / f(in meters) = 1 / 0.25 m = +4 Dioptres (D).
questions.source: JEE Main 2019 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 9

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following carbocations is the MOST stable?
questions.explanation: Tertiary butyl carbocation (CH3)3C+ is stabilized by 9 α-hydrogens via hyperconjugation and three +I methyl groups.
questions.source: JEE Main 2019 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 12

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: If the distance r between two point charges in vacuum is doubled while keeping charges constant, the electrostatic force becomes:
questions.explanation: By Coulomb's law, F ∝ 1/r². Doubling r to 2r reduces F to F/4.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2020 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 1

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Markovnikov's rule for addition of HBr to propene in the absence of peroxides yields predominantly:
questions.explanation: Electrophilic addition proceeds via the more stable secondary carbocation, yielding 2-bromopropane as the major product.
questions.source: JEE Main 2020 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 13

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: For an ideal solution formed by mixing two volatile liquids, which condition holds true?
questions.explanation: Ideal solutions obey Raoult's law at all concentrations with ΔmixH = 0 and ΔmixV = 0.
questions.source: JEE Main 2021 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 2

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: The efficiency of a Carnot engine operating between a hot reservoir at 600 K and a cold reservoir at 300 K is:
questions.explanation: Carnot efficiency η = 1 - (Tc / Th) = 1 - (300 / 600) = 0.5 = 50%.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2021 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 12

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: A constant net force of 20 N acts on a body of mass 4 kg initially at rest. What is its acceleration?
questions.explanation: By Newton's second law, a = F / m = 20 N / 4 kg = 5 m/s².
questions.source: JEE Main 2022 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Physics Ch. 5

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: SN2 reactions of optically active alkyl halides proceed with:
questions.explanation: SN2 is a concerted backside-attack mechanism, resulting in 100% inversion of stereochemical configuration.
questions.source: JEE Main 2022 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 10

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Two capacitors of 4 µF and 4 µF are connected in series. Their equivalent capacitance is:
questions.explanation: In series, 1/Ceq = 1/4 + 1/4 = 1/2 → Ceq = 2 µF.
questions.source: JEE Main 2023 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 2

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: The spin-only magnetic moment of Fe²⁺ ion (atomic number Z = 26) in Bohr Magnetons (BM) is:
questions.explanation: Fe²⁺ has configuration [Ar] 3d⁶ with n = 4 unpaired electrons. μ = √(n(n+2)) = √(4 × 6) = √24 ≈ 4.90 BM.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2023 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 8

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: Lenz's law is a direct consequence of the law of conservation of:
questions.explanation: Induced emf always opposes the change in magnetic flux that produces it, requiring mechanical work that converts to electrical energy (conservation of energy).
questions.source: JEE Main 2024 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 6

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: According to Molecular Orbital Theory, the bond order of the O2 molecule is:
questions.explanation: O2 has 10 bonding and 6 antibonding electrons: Bond Order = (10 - 6) / 2 = 2.0 (and is paramagnetic due to 2 unpaired electrons in π*2p).
questions.source: JEE Main 2024 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 11 Chemistry Ch. 4

questions.subject: physics
questions.question: At resonance in a series LCR circuit, the impedance Z of the circuit equals:
questions.explanation: At resonance XL = XC, so Z = √(R² + (XL - XC)²) = R, and current reaches its maximum value.
questions.source: JEE Main 2025 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Physics Ch. 7

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.question: Which reaction converts a primary amide (RCONH2) into a primary amine (RNH2) with one carbon atom less?
questions.explanation: Treating an amide with Br2 in aqueous/ethanolic NaOH yields a primary amine containing one carbon less than the parent amide.
questions.source: JEE Advanced 2025 Prep Bank / NCERT Class 12 Chemistry Ch. 13
